schema.text: Does heavy or fast traffic on your route change how you ride your e-scooter?

options.text: I notice it, but it rarely changes my comfort or route
It sometimes makes riding less pleasant
It often makes me feel stressed or unsafe
I change my route or time to avoid it

it.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Il traffico intenso o veloce sul tuo percorso cambia il modo in cui vai in monopattino elettrico?
it.#No, traffic doesn't bother me: No, il traffico non mi dà fastidio
it.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Me ne accorgo, ma raramente cambia la mia comodità o il percorso
it.#It sometimes makes riding less pleasant: A volte rende meno piacevole andare in monopattino
it.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Spesso mi mette sotto stress o mi fa sentire poco al sicuro
it.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Cambio percorso o orario per evitarlo

fr.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Une circulation dense ou rapide sur votre trajet change-t-elle votre façon de rouler en trottinette électrique ?
fr.#No, traffic doesn't bother me: Non, la circulation ne me gêne pas
fr.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Je le remarque, mais cela change rarement mon confort ou mon trajet
fr.#It sometimes makes riding less pleasant: Cela rend parfois le trajet moins agréable
fr.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Cela me stresse ou me fait souvent sentir en danger
fr.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Je change d'itinéraire ou d'horaire pour l'éviter

de.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Verändert starker oder schneller Verkehr auf Ihrer Strecke, wie Sie E-Scooter fahren?
de.#No, traffic doesn't bother me: Nein, der Verkehr stört mich nicht
de.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Ich merke es, aber es ändert selten mein Wohlbefinden oder meine Strecke
de.#It sometimes makes riding less pleasant: Manchmal macht es das Fahren weniger angenehm
de.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Oft fühle ich mich dadurch gestresst oder unsicher
de.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Ich ändere Route oder Zeit, um es zu vermeiden

tr.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Güzergâhınızdaki yoğun veya hızlı trafik elektrikli scooter kullanma şeklinizi değiştiriyor mu?
tr.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Fark ederim ama konforumu veya güzergâhımı nadiren değiştirir
tr.#It sometimes makes riding less pleasant: Bazen scooter kullanmayı daha az keyifli hâle getirir
tr.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Sık sık stresli veya güvensiz hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Bundan kaçınmak için güzergâhımı veya saatimi değiştiririm

fa.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: آیا ترافیک سنگین یا پرسرعت در مسیر شما شیوهٔ اسکوترسواری شما را تغییر می‌دهد؟
fa.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: متوجه آن می‌شوم، اما به‌ندرت راحتی یا مسیر مرا تغییر می‌دهد
fa.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: اغلب باعث می‌شود احساس تنش یا ناامنی کنم
fa.#I change my route or time to avoid it: برای دوری از آن، مسیر یا زمان خود را تغییر می‌دهم

hu.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Befolyásolja az útvonalán a sűrű vagy gyors forgalom, hogyan közlekedik elektromos rollerrel?
hu.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Észreveszem, de ritkán változtat a kényelmemen vagy az útvonalamon
hu.#It sometimes makes riding less pleasant: Néha kevésbé élvezetessé teszi a rollerezést
hu.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Gyakran feszültté tesz, vagy nem érzem tőle biztonságban magam
hu.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy az időpontot, hogy elkerüljem

ar.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: هل تغيّر حركة المرور الكثيفة أو السريعة على طريقك طريقة ركوبك للسكوتر الكهربائي؟
ar.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: ألاحظها، لكنها نادرًا ما تغيّر راحتي أو طريقي
ar.#It sometimes makes riding less pleasant: تجعل ركوب السكوتر أقل متعة أحيانًا
ar.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: تجعلني غالبًا أشعر بالتوتر أو بعدم الأمان
